packs.note: The manual lists macOS keys; per its own rule Command maps to Ctrl and Option to Alt on Windows.
The Unity 6 manual no longer publishes a full default list (Edit > Shortcuts shows it); only shortcuts named on current manual pages are here.
IntelliJ keymap (the IntelliJ-family default). Rider lets the user pick a keymap at first start (Visual Studio 2022, Visual Studio, VS Code, ReSharper are the others); check Settings > Keymap.
Most of these work while the Spotify window is in front; Play/Pause from anywhere is core.media.
